_meta.description: Rolling stock for Line 12. No supplier is appointed yet. The design values below are DPR planning assumptions, not a procured train. The UI must say so.

procurement.value: Not yet awarded. Included in the systems tender floated in June 2026.

dpr_design_assumptions.notes: Verified as DPR assumptions (April 2019). The procured train may differ.

reported_operations.value: 6-car rakes shared with Line 5; 5 to 7 minute peak frequency; 6 AM to 10 PM
reported_operations.notes: Single trade-press source (Aug 2025). The DPR plans 3-car trains first and 5 AM to midnight operation.

model_guidance: Build the 3D train as a generic 3.2 m wide stainless-steel metro car in a 3-car set with an orange line livery. Do not copy any manufacturer's design.

image.alt: Line 5 metro train in deep blue livery with orange and brown bands
image.caption: The Line 5 train design. Line 12 extends Line 5, but Line 12's own trains are not ordered yet.
image.notes: Owner to add: put the file in public/images/ (e.g. /images/line5-train.jpg), set src, credit and source_url. Only use an image you have the right to publish.

line5_contract.scope: Rolling stock, CBTC signalling and train control, telecom, platform screen doors, and depot machinery at Kasheli, with 2 years of defect liability and 5 years of maintenance
line5_contract.notes: Line 5's contract, not Line 12's. Line 12's trains are in its own systems tender (June 2026). Award date not pinned down: reports range from mid to late 2025.
